# James Oliver

> Papers by James Oliver. Each piece is listed with its one-sentence claim. Links point to the markdown source, with equations in LaTeX.

## Papers

- [The Buildable Sphere](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/geodesic-dome.md): The sphere encloses a volume with the least surface, a sphere cannot be built from flat parts and geodesic domes approach it without limit.
- [The Area-Energy Principle](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/area-energy-principle.md): To exchange the most energy a thing presents the most surface and to exchange the least it presents the least.
- [The Ideal Gas Law](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/ideal-gas-law.md): Temperature is the energy each molecule of a thin gas carries and pressure is the push the crowd of molecules delivers to a surface, so they are two measurements of one motion and the gas law relates them.
- [Moving Mass Over Land](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/moving-mass-over-land.md): Moving mass over level land costs only friction with the ground and with the air, which hard wheels on hard rails and cars coupled in one line each drive toward zero.
- [Entropy Is a Count](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/entropy-is-a-count.md): Entropy is the count of the arrangements that fit a description and a shuffled system is found where the count is largest.
- [Collect or Release](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/collect-or-release.md): We either collect energy already in motion or release energy held in a store and what separates the two is whether the source refills faster than we draw on it.
- [Renewable Energy Is Nuclear](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/renewable-energy-is-nuclear.md): Sunlight, wind, falling water, wood and coal are one source, the fusion of hydrogen in the Sun, reaching us after different delays.
- [Why Some Systems Last and Others Decay](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/why-some-systems-last-and-others-decay.md): A system that removes errors more slowly than they arrive has a lifespan and one that removes them faster has only a half-life.
